newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Securities to open office in Hanoi.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Securities to open office in Hanoi.

text.p: Japan's Daiwa Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday that it had been given permission by Vietnam to set up a representative office in Hanoi.

Daiwa said it plans to open the office by the end of this year. It said the purpose of the office would be to collect information about Vietnam's future capital market and economy and foreign companies doing business in that country.

Daiwa said the office would also concentrate on supporting privatisation projects of state-owned firms and possible issues of foreign bonds, before the eventual setting up of a stock exchange in Vietnam allowed it to trade securities.
